districts.name: Central District
districts.character: Commercial and administrative heart: skyline towers, civic buildings, hotels, plazas and broad boulevards.

districts.name: Market Quarter
districts.character: Dense everyday commerce: covered markets, shophouses, stalls, supermarkets, loading yards and busy lanes.

districts.name: North Heights
districts.character: Premium residential district on the rise: villas, mansions, gated compounds and landscaped crescents.

districts.name: Old Town
districts.character: The historic core above the old harbour: courtyard houses, narrow lanes, shophouses and the Kesari Royal Court.

districts.name: Industrial District
districts.character: Employment and logistics across the Ose River: factories, warehouses, workshops, the port and the works.

districts.name: Green Estates
districts.character: Quieter family suburbs: semi-detached homes, terraces, apartment blocks, schools, clinics and tree-lined streets.

districts.name: Vora Outskirts
districts.character: Farmland, scrub and scattered compounds along the roads out of the city.

landmarks.name: Vora National Stadium
landmarks.description: The 40,000-seat national stadium and sports complex.

landmarks.name: Vora Port
landmarks.description: Container quay, cranes, sheds and the lagoon pilot station.

landmarks.name: Municipal Water & Power Works
landmarks.description: Power station, water treatment basins and the city substation.

landmarks.name: Adanse Grand Market
landmarks.description: Covered halls, open courtyards and hundreds of stalls - the commercial engine of the Market Quarter.

landmarks.name: Liberty Park
landmarks.description: The central park: lawns, a lake, shaded paths and the Liberty Monument.

landmarks.name: State Secretariat
landmarks.description: Government offices and the High Court of V.

landmarks.name: Vora Central Terminal
landmarks.description: Intercity and city bus terminal with sheltered bays, taxi ranks and a motor park.

landmarks.name: Central Police & Fire
landmarks.description: Police headquarters and the central fire station.

landmarks.name: St. Anne Cathedral
landmarks.description: Twin-towered cathedral and its gardens.

landmarks.name: Kesari Royal Court
landmarks.description: The historic royal court of the Kesari dynasty, with its carved veranda posts and courtyards.

landmarks.name: V Cultural Centre
landmarks.description: National theatre, galleries and the open-air amphitheatre.

landmarks.name: Vora City Hall
landmarks.description: Seat of the city administration: a domed hall with a colonnaded forecourt.

landmarks.name: Hilltop Gardens
landmarks.description: Hilltop park of North Heights with views over the city.

landmarks.name: Palm Crescent Mall
landmarks.description: The major shopping complex of the city with its own parking grounds.

landmarks.name: Unity Square
landmarks.description: The signature civic square of Vora City, facing City Hall across Meridian Avenue.

landmarks.name: Meridian Tower
landmarks.description: The tallest building in V: a 42-storey glass tower on a retail podium.

landmarks.name: Vora Central Mosque
landmarks.description: Domed congregational mosque with twin minarets and a walled courtyard.

landmarks.name: Old Harbour & Fish Market
landmarks.description: Fish market, boat landing and the harbour square at the end of Old Harbour Road.

landmarks.name: JAG House
landmarks.description: The walled hillside estate of the JAG family on Ridge Street: the mansion, its gardens, pool and staff quarters. The player's home.

landmarks.name: Acacia Park
landmarks.description: Neighbourhood park and playground of Green Estates.

landmarks.name: Vora General Hospital
landmarks.description: The main teaching hospital with wards, emergency bays and a helipad.

landmarks.name: Old Town Market
landmarks.description: The neighbourhood market of Old Town: sheds, stalls and craft workshops.

landmarks.name: North Gate
landmarks.description: The monumental gateway on Meridian Avenue welcoming travellers from the north.

landmarks.name: Unity Bridge
landmarks.description: Cable-stayed crossing of the Ose River linking the city centre to the Industrial District.
